title: 863. Reordered Power of 2

examples.explanation: No rearrangement is a power of two.
16 itself is a power of two.

hints: Compare sorted digit strings: `n` works exactly when its digit signature matches that of some power of two with the same length.
Precompute the signatures of all powers of two up to 2^30 once, then each query is a lookup.
Counting digits avoids enumerating permutations, which would be far too slow.
